ROOTED IN NIAGARA. MADE FOR CONNECTION.

Good company.
Great memories.

We believe the most memorable celebrations are the ones that bring people a little closer.

A little play
goes a long way.

After more than a decade in the event industry, we noticed something: the moments people remembered weren’t always the grand ones. Sometimes, they started with a game.

Niagara Wedding and Event Rentals grew from that simple idea. Our handcrafted games create space for laughter, friendly competition and new connections, while looking right at home at your celebration.

From weddings and birthday parties to team barbecues, we take care of the details so you can enjoy your people.

OUR COMMUNITY MATTERS

Bringing Niagara
a little closer.

Our commitment to connection extends beyond celebrations. We’re proud to support community organizations including Big Brothers Big Sisters Niagara, Pathstone Mental Health and Safe Space Niagara.

Planning something that brings people together? We’d love to hear about it.
